review_scope: Six complete access, audit/defaults, budgets, Discussions, Copilot and evaluator support files.

claims.statement: Collaborator evaluation advises teams when the slice is empty and counts admin, write/maintain and read permissions otherwise. Triage and unrecognized roles are not counted in these buckets, and a nil collaborator element is not guarded here. Empty input must not imply a complete authorized inventory.
claims.source_authority: Pinned upstream evaluator implementation and inline advice, static review.
contexts: Upstream preferences and severity are separate from adopted local obligations.
Evidence availability, entitlement, completeness and effective enforcement remain distinct.

conflicts_and_limits: EVALA-009 positive budget message claims alerting for all despite any-budget condition.
EVALA-005/007 defaults and unavailable/unknown settings do not prove effective existing-repository enforcement.
EVALA-011/013 optional AI adoption and feature preferences require local intent, privacy and cost decisions.
EVALA-015/016 empty findings can arise from missing registry or data and cannot clear compliance.
